label: Engine displacement
intended_effect: physical engine swept volume used by air model
explicit_non_effects: does not tune VE injector flow spark or idle

label: Cylinder count
intended_effect: defines cylinder count for derived per-cylinder quantities

label: Injector count
intended_effect: defines number of installed active injectors
explicit_non_effects: does not change per-injector design flow

label: Injector design flow
intended_effect: defines injector characterized mass flow at design pressure
explicit_non_effects: does not compensate VE deadtime or short-pulse error

label: Injector design pressure
intended_effect: defines pressure paired with injector design flow
explicit_non_effects: does not represent current regulator setting

label: Operating fuel pressure
intended_effect: defines measured current TBI fuel pressure

label: Effective injector flow
intended_effect: reports pressure-corrected injector flow actually used

label: Fuel stoichiometric AFR
intended_effect: defines stoichiometric fuel chemistry reference
explicit_non_effects: does not command enrichment by itself

label: TPS closed voltage
intended_effect: defines zero-percent TPS transfer point

label: TPS WOT voltage
intended_effect: defines 100-percent TPS transfer point

label: MAP low transfer voltage
intended_effect: defines low electrical point of MAP transfer

label: MAP low transfer pressure
intended_effect: defines pressure paired with MAP low voltage

label: MAP high transfer voltage
intended_effect: defines high electrical point of MAP transfer

label: MAP high transfer pressure
intended_effect: defines pressure paired with MAP high voltage

label: Wideband low transfer voltage
intended_effect: defines low voltage of WB controller analog transfer

label: Wideband lambda at low voltage
intended_effect: defines lambda paired with WB low voltage

label: Wideband high transfer voltage
intended_effect: defines high voltage of WB controller analog transfer

label: Wideband lambda at high voltage
intended_effect: defines lambda paired with WB high voltage

label: Speed-density VE
intended_effect: corrects speed-density modeled cylinder filling
explicit_non_effects: does not compensate injector or transient fuel errors

label: Alpha-N filling
intended_effect: defines Alpha-N effective filling estimate

label: Alpha-N steady authority
intended_effect: sets steady Alpha-N blend authority at high pressure ratio
explicit_non_effects: does not change either airflow table

label: Alpha-N tip-in authority
intended_effect: sets temporary Alpha-N authority on throttle opening

label: Alpha-N tip-out authority
intended_effect: sets temporary Alpha-N authority on throttle closing

label: Alpha-N authority rise rate
intended_effect: controls how quickly transient Alpha-N authority rises
explicit_non_effects: does not change airflow table values

label: Alpha-N authority decay rate
intended_effect: controls return from transient Alpha-N authority

label: Alpha-N maximum authority
intended_effect: bounds total Alpha-N blend authority

label: Normal target lambda
intended_effect: sets normal non-PE combustion target
explicit_non_effects: does not change injector flow or VE

label: PE target lambda
intended_effect: sets commanded enriched lambda while PE active

label: Cranking fuel mass
intended_effect: sets dedicated cranking fuel request versus coolant temperature
explicit_non_effects: does not alter run VE or afterstart

label: Afterstart initial excess
intended_effect: sets post-run-entry initial enrichment excess

label: Afterstart decay time
intended_effect: sets afterstart enrichment decay time constant
explicit_non_effects: does not alter startup IAC decay

label: Warmup fuel factor
intended_effect: sets temperature-dependent run enrichment
explicit_non_effects: does not change afterstart or AE

label: AE TPS gain
intended_effect: scales additive transient fuel from positive TPS rate

label: AE MAP gain
intended_effect: scales additive transient fuel from positive MAP rate

label: AE decay
intended_effect: controls decay of additive AE fuel state
explicit_non_effects: does not change air-model transient decay

label: AE maximum fuel
intended_effect: bounds additive AE fuel mass

label: Injector deadtime
intended_effect: compensates electrical opening delay versus battery voltage
explicit_non_effects: does not compensate short-pulse hydraulic nonlinearity

label: Short-pulse correction
intended_effect: linearizes injector delivery at short effective open time
explicit_non_effects: does not change injector rated flow

label: Minimum command PW
intended_effect: sets final hardware safety/minimum command clamp

label: Maximum command PW
intended_effect: sets final command PW ceiling
explicit_non_effects: does not change requested fuel mass

label: Feedback mode
intended_effect: selects open-loop narrowband wideband or dual feedback architecture
explicit_non_effects: does not alter base fuel calibration

label: Narrowband integral rate
intended_effect: sets NB rich/lean integrator response rate

label: Narrowband minimum correction
intended_effect: sets lean-fuel correction lower authority bound

label: Narrowband maximum correction
intended_effect: sets rich-fuel correction upper authority bound

label: Narrowband stoich window
intended_effect: limits NB operation to near-stoich targets

label: Wideband proportional gain
intended_effect: sets immediate WB response to lambda error

label: Wideband integral gain
intended_effect: sets accumulated WB correction rate

label: Wideband minimum correction
intended_effect: bounds minimum WB fuel correction

label: Wideband maximum correction
intended_effect: bounds maximum WB fuel correction

label: Dual-mode NB centering rate
intended_effect: sets slow NB centering bias while WB remains primary
explicit_non_effects: does not create a second fast fuel loop

label: Dual NB minimum bias
intended_effect: bounds slow dual-mode NB bias below unity

label: Dual NB maximum bias
intended_effect: bounds slow dual-mode NB bias above unity

label: Run entry RPM
intended_effect: sets crank-to-run RPM qualification threshold
explicit_non_effects: does not set target idle RPM

label: Run entry confirm time
intended_effect: sets time RPM must remain above run threshold

label: REF timeout multiplier
intended_effect: scales stale-REF timeout from last REF period

label: Minimum REF timeout
intended_effect: sets minimum stale-REF timeout

label: Stall confirm time
intended_effect: sets duration of invalid rotation before confirmed stall
explicit_non_effects: does not grant stale fuel/spark commands

label: PE pressure-ratio entry
intended_effect: sets load-based PE entry threshold

label: PE pressure-ratio exit
intended_effect: sets load-based PE hysteresis exit threshold

label: PE TPS entry
intended_effect: sets throttle-demand PE entry threshold

label: PE TPS exit
intended_effect: sets throttle-demand PE exit threshold

label: PE entry delay
intended_effect: sets sustained PE request delay

label: DFCO TPS entry
intended_effect: sets closed-throttle DFCO entry threshold
explicit_non_effects: does not set idle TPS threshold

label: DFCO TPS exit
intended_effect: sets DFCO throttle hysteresis exit
explicit_non_effects: does not set PE TPS threshold

label: DFCO RPM entry
intended_effect: sets minimum RPM for DFCO entry

label: DFCO RPM exit
intended_effect: sets RPM for DFCO exit

label: DFCO pressure-ratio entry
intended_effect: sets low-load pressure condition for DFCO entry

label: DFCO pressure-ratio exit
intended_effect: sets DFCO load hysteresis exit
explicit_non_effects: does not alter PE load threshold

label: DFCO entry delay
intended_effect: sets sustained coast condition before fuel cut

label: Key-off voltage threshold
intended_effect: sets inferred key-off voltage boundary
explicit_non_effects: does not act as injector battery fallback

label: Key-off confirm time
intended_effect: debounces inferred key-off condition

label: Shutdown housekeeping delay
intended_effect: sets internal post-keyoff execution window

label: Fuel pump prime time
intended_effect: sets key-on pump prime duration
